compatibility: Saved configuration dictionaries and warmup keys accept retired defaults. Alternate retired values raise ValueError. Explicit and defaulted factory options share a canonical specialization key.

protocol.conditioning: Hot reuses shared prepared weights. Rotating reads 256 MiB eviction, activations and row scales before each trial outside measured events.
protocol.measurements: Median GPU-event us inside captured graphs. Both versions share identical input, packed-weight, scale and reference-exponent storage. Paired trial order is randomized. Conditioning and compilation are outside the measured events.
protocol.correctness: Sampled independent FP32 MXFP4 decode/reference, plus bitwise full-output baseline equality and changed-input graph replay. BF16 and FP16, E4M3/E5M2/grouped scaling, static/dynamic rows, tails, fragment/padded LDS and one/two stages are covered.
protocol.isa: Disassemble exact executed ELF objects with llvm-objdump for gfx1201. Fingerprints include instruction mnemonics and operands, excluding addresses and comments. Resource counts come from AMDHSA metadata.
protocol.limitations: Point estimates over the listed cases and two GPUs. The serving comparison remains pinned to ce625eb.
